svg.metadata: {"story":"Deborah","act":1,"chapter":"Ch.1 · Under the Palm","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Deborah, a prophetess and judge, sits beneath the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel, hearing the disputes of Israel.
